## bodh-p05-v41 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Non-dual nectar past compare drunk quenches poison-fever. Bliss-method for Śiva-winning, great souls', Kṣema-king's pure treatise.

*Rasa: amṛta-śānta of quenched fever; maṅgala-śānta of pure treatise — The sthāyibhāva is nectar-peace: told, drunk, quenched. Quenching relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: method, owner, purity. Purity relished.*
